scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build:builder
scripts.test:shared: node --test tests/runtime-config.test.mjs tests/company-config.test.mjs tests/text-encoding.test.mjs tests/legacy-panels.test.mjs tests/host-security.test.mjs tests/firebase-config.test.mjs tests/firestore-rules-consistency.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:engine && npm run test:shared && npm run test:mobile && npm --prefix builder-react run test && npm --prefix straight-wire-backend run test
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,builder-watch "npm run dev:backend" "npm run build:builder:watch"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently -n backend,builder,host "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:builder" "npm run dev:host"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n workflow,viewer,mobile "npm run workflow:start" "npm run viewer:start" "npm run mobile:start"
